name: Kurodeba
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Slot none; Price 12,000 gp; Weight 2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Kurodeba measures 27 inches long, with a 19- inch, single-edged blade of black steel and a full tang. The sword’s collar, guard and buttcap are fashioned from the same black steel as the blade and the wooden handle is wrapped with cords of black silk. Kurodeba functions as a +2 wakizashi which, when gripped, also grants its user a +1 dodge bonus to AC and an additional +2 bonus when confirming critical hits.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells cat’s grace, keen; Cost 6,000 gp.
